usage: agentware skill add [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--source SOURCE]
                           [--allow-external] [--harness-path HARNESS_PATH]
                           [name]

positional arguments:
  name                  catalog skill name (omit only with --source)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --source SOURCE       LOCAL path to a non-catalog skill (gated; never a URL)
  --allow-external      confirm install of an external (--source) skill
  --harness-path HARNESS_PATH
                        install into this harness skills dir instead of the
                        indexed external KB (e.g. .agents/skills)
